answer: Continuous retraining on live operational data exposes a machine learning system to poisoning attacks because it increases the risk of incorporating maliciously altered data into the training set. If the model is retrained using data that has been compromised or manipulated, it can lead to the model learning from this "poisoned" data, resulting in degraded performance or unexpected behaviors. This vulnerability arises from the fact that the system may not have adequate safeguards to detect and filter out harmful inputs during the retraining process.
